item.title: ‘Clear message’ sent as Bolton confirms partner for £200m Crompton Place
item.description: As first revealed by Place North West, MEPC, the developer arm of global investor Federated Hermes, will lead the transformation of four acres at the heart of the town centre – a scheme described by the council’s Leader as a “once-in-a-generation opportunity to create something everyone in Bolton can be proud of”. The post ‘Clear message’ sent as Bolton confirms partner for £200m Crompton Place appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Taylor Wimpey lodges £37.5m resi plans for former Glen Dimplex factory
item.description: After more than a year of sitting vacant, the 235,100 sq ft manufacturing facility in Knowsley could be demolished to make way for a mix of 204 terraced, semi-detached, and detached houses. The post Taylor Wimpey lodges £37.5m resi plans for former Glen Dimplex factory appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Oryx makes Ashton-under-Lyne industrial buy
item.description: Making the first investment from its £100m industrial fund, the investor and development partner Pembury intend to deliver a five-unit scheme on a 9.3-acre site. The post Oryx makes Ashton-under-Lyne industrial buy appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Tim Rackham becomes Applethwaite MD
item.description: Having joined Eric Wright Group’s housebuilding arm as commercial director three years ago, Rackham now steps up to lead the division. The post Tim Rackham becomes Applethwaite MD appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Starbucks and 80-bed care home planned for Offerton
item.description: Torsion Care and Thistlewood Properties are seeking consent to demolish the existing four-storey BT building off Brundrett Street and deliver a mixed-use scheme in its place. The post Starbucks and 80-bed care home planned for Offerton appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Willmott Dixon starts on £14m Cheshire Constabulary base
item.description: Replacing a RAAC and asbestos-impacted 60-year-old Crewe police station, the 22,500 sq ft new-build is lined up to open early next year and to be net zero in operation. The post Willmott Dixon starts on £14m Cheshire Constabulary base appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Refresh planned for Northern Quarter adult shops
item.description: The former Big in Amsterdam and Love Boutique outlets on Tib Street are to be pulled down and replaced with a three-and-a-half-storey building featuring retail and leisure space, under plans lodged with the city council. The post Refresh planned for Northern Quarter adult shops appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Stockport retail warehouse primed for sale
item.description: B&M and Dreams occupy the two-unit 18,500 sq ft Great Portwood Street building, which is available for just shy of £3.2m. The post Stockport retail warehouse primed for sale appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Reds reveal academy overhaul plans
item.description: Proposals to upgrade Liverpool FC’s youth development facility have been lodged, with architect KSS on board for design work. The post Reds reveal academy overhaul plans appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester construction starts drop for second year running as headwinds bite
item.description: Just 17 schemes broke ground in Manchester and Salford in 2025, down from a record low 20 the year before, but pipelines across all sectors remain chunky, according to Deloitte’s annual crane survey. The post Manchester construction starts drop for second year running as headwinds bite appeared first on Place North West.
